name: ghost-ai-coding-assistant
description: AI Coding Assistant powered by Ollama, MLX/VLM, OpenAI-compatible servers, and OpenCode

ghost.settingsSchemaVersion.description: Internal Ghost settings schema version. Do not edit manually.
ghost.settingsSchemaVersion.markdownDescription: Internal Ghost settings schema version. Ghost migrates older settings automatically.

ghost.openCodeUrl.description: User-managed OpenCode headless server URL. Ghost never starts or stops this server.

ghost.openCodeUsername.description: HTTP Basic Auth username for OpenCode. Store the password with Ghost: Set Provider API Key.

ghost.openCodeAgent.description: Optional OpenCode agent id. Leave empty to use the OpenCode default agent.

enumDescriptions: Reuse a dedicated OpenCode session for each Ghost conversation.
Create a fresh OpenCode session for every Ghost request.
ghost.openCodeSessionReuse.description: How Ghost preserves OpenCode context between requests.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI-compatible chat completions or responses API.
Custom local HTTP server using the configured paths and request template.
ghost.openaiProfile.description: Compatibility profile used by the OpenAI-compatible provider.

ghost.openaiCustomChatPath.description: Custom HTTP chat request path. Supports {{model}} in the path.

ghost.openaiCustomRequestTemplate.description: Custom HTTP JSON request template. Exact placeholders become typed JSON values.

ghost.openaiApiKeyHeader.description: Header name used for the provider API key. The key value remains in VS Code SecretStorage.

ghost.openaiApiKeyPrefix.description: Optional prefix for the provider API key header, such as Bearer.

ghost.openaiOrganizationHeader.description: Header name used for the optional organization identifier.

ghost.openaiOrganization.description: Optional organization identifier sent to the OpenAI-compatible server.

ghost.openaiProjectHeader.description: Header name used for the optional project identifier.

ghost.openaiProject.description: Optional project identifier sent to the OpenAI-compatible server.

ghost.openaiProxy.description: Optional HTTP or HTTPS proxy for OpenAI-compatible requests. Do not put credentials in this URL.

ghost.openaiNoProxy.description: Comma- or space-separated hosts that bypass the OpenAI-compatible proxy.

ghost.openaiTlsRejectUnauthorized.description: Verify OpenAI-compatible HTTPS certificates. Disable only for a trusted development endpoint.

ghost.openaiTlsCaFile.description: Optional path to a PEM CA file for OpenAI-compatible HTTPS.

ghost.openaiTlsCertFile.description: Optional path to a client certificate PEM file for OpenAI-compatible HTTPS.

ghost.openaiTlsKeyFile.description: Optional path to a client private key PEM file for OpenAI-compatible HTTPS.

ghost.autocompleteModel.description: Model used for inline code completions.

ghost.providerRequestTimeoutMinutes.title: Provider HTTP timeout (minutes)
ghost.providerRequestTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum minutes to wait for one HTTP request to the model provider. This is not the overall agent run budget.

ghost.inlineCompletionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for one inline completion.

ghost.requestTimeLimitMinutes.title: Agent request time limit (minutes)
ghost.requestTimeLimitMinutes.description: Maximum minutes a Ghost agent request may run, including tool rounds. This is the safety budget, not the provider HTTP timeout.

ghost.seed.description: Optional deterministic generation seed when the provider supports it.

ghost.stopSequences.description: Sequences that stop generation when the provider supports them.

ghost.contextWindow.description: Optional provider context window. Ollama sends this as num_ctx.

ghost.grammar.description: Optional provider grammar constraint, when supported.

ghost.jsonMode.description: Request JSON object responses from providers that support JSON mode when native tools are not active.

ghost.modelProfile.description: Active named model profile. Leave empty to use the normal Ghost settings.

ghost.modelAliases.description: Map friendly model aliases to provider model IDs, for example {"fast": "qwen2.5-coder:1.5b"}.

ghost.modelProfiles.description: Named model profiles. Each profile can select different chat, agent, vision, and autocomplete models plus generation settings.

ghost.maxContextTokens.description: Maximum number of context tokens sent to the model.

enumDescriptions: Use an MLX VLM OpenAI-compatible server.
Delegate requests to a user-managed OpenCode headless server.
ghost.provider.markdownDescription: Ghost model provider. See the [provider parameter guide](https://github.com/MickyBalladelli/Ghost/blob/main/OLLAMA_PARAMETERS.md) for the settings each provider uses.

ghost.topP.description: Nucleus sampling: keep tokens within this cumulative probability.

ghost.topK.description: Keep only the top K likely tokens. Lower values are more focused.

ghost.minP.description: Discard tokens below this probability relative to the most likely token.

ghost.presencePenalty.description: Penalize tokens that already appeared. Positive values encourage new topics.

ghost.repeatPenalty.description: Penalize repeated text. Values above 1 penalize repetition more strongly.

ghost.responseLength.description: Default response length for the Ghost interface.

ghost.mode.description: Default chat workflow mode. Plan inspects the workspace with read-only tools and records implementation steps.

enumDescriptions: Ask before applying each file write or edit. Legacy mirror of ghost.autoAcceptScope confirm.
Apply file writes and edits without asking during a request. Legacy mirror of a non-confirm autoAcceptScope; Ghost stores request, not always.
ghost.fileEditApproval.description: Legacy mirror of ghost.autoAcceptScope. Use autoAcceptScope. auto means request-scoped auto-accept, not always.

enumDescriptions: Auto-accept one file edit, then ask again.
Auto-accept edits to one file during the current request.
Auto-accept file edits during the current request.
Auto-accept file edits during this Ghost session.
Auto-accept file edits in this workspace.
Auto-accept file edits everywhere. Use with care.
ghost.autoAcceptScope.description: Scope for automatic file-edit approval. Terminal and other dangerous tools always require explicit approval.

ghost.enableConversationPersistence.description: Persist Ghost conversations and preferences in VS Code storage. Disable to keep chat history in memory only.

ghost.logLevel.description: Local-only Ghost log level. Logs appear in the Ghost Logs output channel and never include detected secrets.

ghost.toolAllowlist.description: Tools Ghost may use automatically. Tools not allowed here ask for approval unless denied. Applies to the Ghost view, @local chat, and registered Language Model tools.

ghost.toolAsklist.description: Tools Ghost must ask about before use. Deny rules override this list. Applies to the Ghost view, @local chat, and registered Language Model tools.

ghost.toolDenylist.description: Tools Ghost must never use. Deny rules override allow and ask rules, including Copilot and other clients that invoke Ghost's registered Language Model tools.

ghost.terminalEnvironmentAllowlist.description: Environment variables Ghost passes to approved terminal commands without asking. Secret-looking names are always excluded.

ghost.terminalEnvironmentAsklist.description: Environment variables Ghost passes to approved terminal commands after asking. Secret-looking names are always excluded.

chatParticipants.name: local
chatParticipants.description: Local AI coding assistant for Ollama, MLX/VLM, OpenAI-compatible servers, and OpenCode

languageModelTools.name: ghost_search_workspace
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search text in the current workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches workspace text with ripgrep and returns structured file, line, column, and matching-line data. Uses fixed-string search by default. The optional path must be inside the workspace.

query.description: Text to search for. Fixed-string matching is used by default.

path.description: Optional workspace file or directory path to search.

glob.description: Optional ripgrep glob filter such as **/*.ts.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_get_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads current VS Code diagnostics from language servers, compilers, and the Problems panel. Provide a workspace-relative or absolute file path for one file, or omit path to use the active file or all workspace diagnostics.

path.description: Optional workspace-relative or absolute file path. Omit to use the active editor file or all workspace diagnostics.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_git_context
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read safe Git context for the workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads non-ignored Git status for the current workspace, a selected-file diff or staged diff, the current branch, or recent history for one file. Use a workspace-relative or absolute path for diff, stagedDiff, and history when no file is active.

path.description: Optional workspace-relative or absolute file or directory path.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_update_task_plan
languageModelTools.userDescription: Persist the current task plan for this conversation.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stores a bounded task plan in the conversation. Use for multi-step work. Keep checked true only for finished steps, set currentStep while working, and include blockers or completion evidence when relevant.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_record_completion
languageModelTools.userDescription: Record the structured result of the current request.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Required before the final answer. Records changed files, checks actually run, failures, and remaining work. Never claim a check was run unless it really ran.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_read_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a text file from the current workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a UTF-8 text file from the current workspace with metadata, encoding, line endings, size, and SHA-256 content hash. Use mode head, tail, lines, bytes, symbol, or matches. The path must be relative to the workspace or an absolute path inside it. Do not use it for binary files.

path.description: Absolute path of the text file to read. The path must be inside the current workspace.

source.description: Read the open editor buffer, including unsaved changes, or the saved disk version. Required when the editor has unsaved changes.

allowSpecialFile.description: Set true only when the user explicitly asks to inspect a generated, vendored, or ignored file. Large and binary files remain blocked.

mode.description: Read mode. Use head or tail with lineCount, lines with startLine/endLine, bytes with startByte/endByte, symbol with symbol, or matches with match.

startLine.description: Optional first line to read. Use this to read a large file in chunks.

endLine.description: Optional last line to read. Keep each read chunk to about 400 lines.

lineCount.description: Number of lines for head or tail mode.

startByte.description: Inclusive UTF-8 byte offset for bytes mode. Use character boundaries.

endByte.description: Exclusive UTF-8 byte offset for bytes mode. Use character boundaries.

symbol.description: Symbol name for symbol mode, such as a class, function, type, or variable.

match.description: Fixed text to find in matching-lines mode.

caseSensitive.description: Whether matching-lines mode treats case as significant.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_write_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create or replace a text file in the current workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new text file or replaces the complete content of an existing file in the current workspace. The path must be relative to the workspace or an absolute path inside it. This changes user files and requires confirmation.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to create or replace. The path must be inside the current workspace.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 text content to write to the file.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_apply_edit
languageModelTools.userDescription: Apply reviewed, structured edits inside the current workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Proposes context-aware edits to a workspace file. Include oldText, oldHash, beforeContext, or afterContext in every hunk so line numbers are checked against current file content. The user must approve the edit before it is applied. Paths must be workspace-relative or absolute inside the workspace.

expectedContent.description: Optional exact content expected before applying the edit.

oldText.description: Optional exact text currently replaced by this hunk. Use it to detect shifted or stale line numbers.

oldHash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the current text replaced by this hunk.

beforeContext.description: Optional exact nearby text immediately before the hunk.

afterContext.description: Optional exact nearby text immediately after the hunk.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_apply_transaction
languageModelTools.userDescription: Apply and verify multiple workspace file edits as one transaction.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Applies 2 to 50 workspace file edits together. Include one content or hunks edit per unique workspace-relative or absolute path. Ghost previews the combined change, verifies every baseline, applies all files, verifies all results, and rolls the group back if any file fails.

content.description: Complete replacement content. Use this or hunks, not both.

expectedContent.description: Optional exact content expected before applying this file edit.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_run_terminal_command
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a shell command in the current workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs a bash or PowerShell command in the current workspace and returns its output. Use only when the user asks for command execution or when it is needed to verify a change. Commands can change the system and require confirmation.

command.description: The bash or PowerShell command to run.

cwd.description: Optional workspace-relative or absolute working directory inside the current workspace.

languageModelTools.name: ghost_list_directory
languageModelTools.userDescription: List files and directories in the current workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists a bounded page of the file and directory hierarchy under a workspace directory. The path must be workspace-relative or absolute inside the current workspace. Use recursive, maxDepth, pageSize, and the returned cursor to inspect large trees safely before reading or editing files.

path.description: Absolute directory path to list. The path must be inside the current workspace.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

pageSize.description: Maximum entries to return in one page.

maxDepth.description: Maximum recursive directory depth. Non-recursive listings use depth 0.

scripts.package: npm run vscode:prepublish && node ./scripts/archiveVsix.js && vsce package && npm run release:check
scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:fast && npm run test:host
